data.text: npm audit signatures fails outright on any install of kadence: blessed@0.1.81 was signed with an npm registry key that expired 2025-01-29, and the command aborts on the first bad signature. A user who wants to check our provenance the standard way gets an error that is not about us. kadence's own SLSA attestation verifies (subject pkg:npm/kadence@0.5.0, built by release.yml, resolved to 088d3a7) — but only if you fetch and parse it by hand from registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/attestations. Worth a line in the README, and it is one more argument for replacing or vendoring blessed.
